name: mfe-shop
description: Convenience scripts only. Each app in container/, login/ and cart/ is a fully independent project.

scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir container install && pnpm --dir login install && pnpm --dir cart install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n container,login,cart -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --dir container start" "pnpm --dir login start" "pnpm --dir cart start"
scripts.build:all: pnpm --dir container build && pnpm --dir login build && pnpm --dir cart build
